reviews.comment:
Tuvimos un problema con el auto a 70 km de ahi. Nos fueron a buscar y nos acompañaron hasta un mecanico para que nos reparen la bomba de agua.
Facundo el que manejaba la grua se quedo con nosotros y nos facilito todo lo que pudo. Impecable su ayuda.
La gente del ACA nos ofrecio habitaciones por si nos teniamos que quedar la noche sin importar haber reservado con tiempo. No hizo falta pero su predisposición estuvo.
Gracias

(Translated by Google)
We had car trouble 70 km away. They came to pick us up and accompanied us to a mechanic to have the water pump repaired.
Facundo, the tow truck driver, stayed with us and helped us in every way he could. His help was impeccable.
The people at the ACA offered us rooms in case we needed to stay the night, even though we had booked in advance. We didn't need them, but they were very helpful.
Thank you.

reviewReply.comment: Muchísimas gracias Lucas por tus palabras. Muchas gracias por tu calificación
